gloss: to giggle; to snicker; to titter

definitions.gloss: to giggle; to snicker; to titter
definitions.explanation: to laugh quietly in a suppressed way, often behind one's hand

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くすくす{笑|わら}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{隠|かく}し→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧くすくす{笑|わら}った。
examples.english: She giggled while covering her mouth with her hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い→言い間違い：08579_iimachigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧{中|じゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦くすくす→くすくす：05771_kusukusu⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らした→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧。
examples.english: The whole class let out stifled giggles at the teacher's slip of the tongue.

notes:
Combines the onomatopoeia ⟦くすくす→くすくす：05771_kusukusu⟧ (the sound of stifled laughter) with ⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to laugh). Describes quiet, suppressed laughing — lighter and more restrained than outright laughter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦くすくす→くすくす：05771_kusukusu⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧: to let out a giggle
- くすくす{笑|わら}い⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to start giggling
- ⟦くすくす→くすくす：05771_kusukusu⟧⟦{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}→笑い声：24414_waraigoe⟧: the sound of giggling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦にやにや→にやにや：05766_niyaniya⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to grin — smiling in a knowing or smug way, without sound
- ⟦げらげら→げらげら：05768_geragera⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to guffaw — loud, unrestrained laughter
- くすっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to chuckle — a single brief, quiet laugh
- {忍|しの}び{笑|わら}い: stifled laugh — trying to hold back laughter

NOTE: ⟦くすくす→くすくす：05771_kusukusu⟧ can have a slightly negative nuance when it implies laughing at someone behind their back.
